capabilities: Visualize scenes as a radial timeline with rings per subplot and four time modes (narrative, chronological, author progress, revision stage)
Lay the same book out in Obsidian Bases views as rows, panels, or an outline
Build Canvas story maps where each subplot gets a lane and scenes can be created by dropping note text
Track writing progress with due dates and statuses (Todo, Working, Complete, Overdue) and revision stages
Export manuscripts via Pandoc with bundled templates
extras: Desktop-only plugin; released under a source-available non-commercial license with pending patent and registered trademark; AI features ship disabled by default; how-to documentation lives on an external docs site.
problem: Longform writers scroll through spreadsheets and files and lose sight of how subplots interweave with the main storyline.

relations.evidence: Radial Timeline and its companion plugin, Editorialist, feature by feature.
Shell commands are run only to invoke Pandoc (and its LaTeX engine) when you export a manuscript
the Timetable lays the same book out in an Obsidian Bases view
Canvas story maps give each subplot its own lane on an Obsidian Canvas

requires.name: Cloud LLM provider API key or local AI server (for AI features)
Radial Timeline Community account (for community sharing)

summary: Interactive radial timeline that arranges a novel's scenes by act, subplot, narrative or chronological order, with progress and revision tracking.
